messages:
leah: deploy-bot paused canary for orders-api chart v3.2.0 in eu-west-2  10% canary showing post-upgrade job failing with env var lookup error and 502s. tagging @omar @sre-oncall. rollback vs overlay patch?
deploy-bot: Canary halted at 10%. Event: job "orders-migrate" failed: env var ORD_DB_SECRET not found in rendered templates. (bot)
omar: looks like chart 3.2.0 renamed secret key from ordersDbSecret -> ORD_DB_SECRET. our eu-west-2 overlay still uses the old key. the chart bump included the rename in the changelog.
tia: options: 1) quick overlay PR to update key and re-run canary (preferred if <25m), 2) rollback to 3.1.7 and pin region, 3) hotpatch k8s secret as a stopgap (risky).
sre-oncall: if traffic is user-impacting we should prefer rollback. how bad are 502s?
leah: error rate spiked to ~1% of requests for the region. not an outage yet but trending. we have 2min headroom before SLO thresholds.
omar: I'll open the overlay fix PR and mark it urgent. PR will update values/eu-west-2.yaml ORD_DB_SECRET: {{ .Values.secrets.database }} and add a short note.
tia: if PR CI passes I'll merge and we can dry-run canary: `deploy-bot promote --chart orders-api:3.2.0 --overlay pr/457 --region eu-west-2 --canary 10 --dry-run`
leah: and if dry-run looks good, run real canary. if PR fails or dry-run shows other template mismatches we rollback. rollback command: `deploy-bot promote --chart orders-api:3.1.7 --region eu-west-2 --force-rollback && deploy-bot pin --chart orders-api:3.1.7 --region eu-west-2`
release-bot: Draft added: "Temporary rollback to orders-api v3.1.7 in eu-west-2 if overlay fix cannot be merged within 25m due to secret key rename in v3.2.0. Action: update overlay OR rollback+pin and re-promote after validation."
omar: PR opened: https://git.company/repos/platform/changes/pulls/457  title: update eu-west-2 overlay for ORD_DB_SECRET rename. cc @leah
tia: CI lint green for overlay. merging now. Holding promotion window for eu-west-2 for 40m to avoid cross-region auto-promote.
deploy-bot: PR merged. Initiating canary for orders-api:3.2.0 in eu-west-2 at 10%. Streaming health...
omar: logs show migrate job succeeded, secret mount present, initial 502s down to baseline.
sre-oncall: monitor for 12m steady-state then advance to 50% if okay.
leah: good work. make sure release notes capture the incident and that we add a pre-promotion lint to check for values key renames.
release-bot: Release notes updated: "Canary for orders-api v3.2.0 in eu-west-2 encountered secret key rename mismatch; overlay was updated and canary completed. Added follow-up to add a promotion gate verifying overlay keys vs chart templates."
tia: follow-up ticket filed: https://git.company/infra/issues/1188  add overlay-key-check to promotion CI.
leah: owners recap: omar  overlay PR (done), tia  hold & canary coordination, sre-oncall  monitor. ETA to full promotion: ~22m.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressed to 50% then 100% with no further regressions. Promotion window released. :tada:
